title: things keeping my codebase alive
caption:
load-bearing code, all four of them.

a TODO from 2021. a catch block that catches everything and tells no one.
a sleep(500) that fixes a race condition nobody can explain. and utils_old.js —
imported nowhere, and somehow the only thing holding login together.

it works. do not ask it why.

what's the one line in your repo you're too scared to delete?
